originalTitle: It looks like Apple’s iPhone 18 really will skip the fall launch this year
summary: According to an Economic Daily News report spotted by MacRumors, executives for Apple supplier Pegatron confirmed during an earnings call that the iPhone 18 Pro series phones will launch this fall, but the base iPhone 18 won't arrive until the first quarter of next year. The more affordable iPhone 18e and a new iPhone Air […]
content: According to an Economic Daily News report spotted by MacRumors, executives for Apple supplier Pegatron confirmed during an earnings call that the iPhone 18 Pro series phones will launch this fall, but the base iPhone 18 won’t arrive until the first quarter of next year. The more affordable iPhone 18e and a new iPhone Air are also rumored to launch around the same time, in line with rumors that have been circulating for more than a year.  Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo and The Information both reported last year that Apple was planning to only launch its premium iPhones in fall 2026, and earlier this year another Apple supplier said one of its customers was postponing a phone launch to early 2027.  Along with the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple’s rumored “Ultra” foldable is reportedly launching this fall. The EDN report cites Pegatron execs saying that memory and chip shortages are causing the peak shipping seasons to shift, as its customers like Apple figure out how to spread out the parts they have and increasingly prioritize higher-priced models that have larger margins.
chineseTitle: 看来苹果 iPhone 18 真的会跳过今年秋季发布会
chineseSummary: 据 MacRumors 发现的《经济日报》报道，苹果供应商和硕高管在财报电话会议上确认，iPhone 18 Pro 系列手机将于今年秋季推出，但基础款 iPhone 18 要到明年第一季度才会上市。更实惠的 iPhone 18e 和新款 iPhone Air [...]
chineseContent: 据 MacRumors 发现的《经济日报》报道，苹果供应商和硕高管在财报电话会议上确认，iPhone 18 Pro 系列手机将于今年秋季推出，但基础版 iPhone 18 要到明年第一季度才会上市。据传，更实惠的 iPhone 18e 和新款 iPhone Air 也将在同一时间推出，这与流传一年多的传言一致。  分析师 Ming-Chi Kuo 和 The Information 去年均报道称，苹果计划仅在 2026 年秋季推出高端 iPhone，而今年早些时候，另一家苹果供应商表示，其一位客户将手机发布推迟到 2027 年初。除了 iPhone 18 Pro 之外，据报道，苹果传闻中的“Ultra”可折叠手机也将于今年秋季推出。 EDN 报告援引和硕高管的话说，内存和芯片短缺正在导致出货旺季发生变化，因为苹果等客户正在考虑如何分散他们拥有的零部件，并越来越多地优先考虑利润率较高的高价机型。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
